name: sheets_read
description: Read data from a Google Sheet range. Specify sheet name and range (e.g., 'A1:C10'). Returns rows as arrays of cell values.

name: sheets_write
description: Write data to a Google Sheet range, overwriting existing values. Specify sheet name, range (e.g., 'A1:C10'), and row data.

values.description: Array of rows, each row is an array of cell values

value_input_option.description: How to interpret input. USER_ENTERED (default) parses formulas/dates/numbers. RAW stores literal strings.

name: sheets_append
description: Append new rows to the end of a Google Sheet table. Specify sheet name and row data to add.

range.description: A1 notation range to append after (e.g., "Sheet1!A1")

value_input_option.description: How to interpret input. USER_ENTERED (default) parses formulas/dates/numbers. RAW stores literal strings.

name: sheets_get_spreadsheet
description: Explore a spreadsheet's structure. Returns title, sheet/tab names, and properties. Use before reading or writing data.

name: sheets_create
description: Create a new Google Spreadsheet. Optionally set title and initial sheet names. Returns spreadsheet ID and sharing URL.
